# PCAT brand assets

`pcat_icon`, `pcat_logo`, `pcat_banner`, and `pcat_social_preview` are size and layout exports of one mark. The mark is a Harvard Crimson circle with a black outline, a white dot, line, square, and cube, and readable `PCAT` lettering inside the circle. The black arrows indicate reversible movement among parameter spaces. There are no alternate logo concepts.

Run `python docs/make_logo.py` from the repository root to regenerate the assets.
